title: What students can do after the help is removed

date_context: A [2025 study of high-school mathematics](https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2422633122) compared a general GPT-4 interface, a tutor configured with learning safeguards and a control group. The general interface improved assisted practice performance, but students later performed worse without it. The reported reduction was 17% relative to the control group's average unassisted performance, rather than 17 percentage points. The guarded tutor's unassisted result was not statistically distinguishable from the control group.

date_context: This is the part of the argument that surprised me when I first put numbers on it. The debate is usually framed as notation versus JSON, as though the format were the system. The format is four per cent of the system. A smaller version of this measurement in September put the syntax at eleven per cent, and the share has fallen since, not because the parser shrank but because everything around it grew. | On size, a hand-tuned schema measured in September came out about 40 per cent larger in characters on the files we open most often. date_context: Consider a weekly appointment at 9 a.m. in Toronto. On Monday, 26 October 2026, that local time corresponds to 13:00 UTC.
